title: ADR-0084：在「去处」表里补一行——组织级（~org）的变更与发布入口
body:
repo:objectstack#5 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CbL6Nn3scsU8yvLyU4

Filing gate: ③ · Source: seat 5's contract review 7202356468 on PR #37579 (#37456), finding S3. Sub-issue of #37424.
Grade: area:ux · Documentation · p2 · evidence: ADR-0084's homes table sends Changes + Publish to 概览's Pending tab. The package-less `~org` scope has no 概览, so #37456 added a `~org`-only "Changes · N" row in the left column that opens the existing sheet. The ADR does not record that home.
Reader: a contract-tier (fable) thread. `docs/adr/**` makes this Tier H.

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化：没有。只是把已经上线的做法写进设计文档：组织级流程没有「概览」，所以它的待发布入口放在左栏那一行「变更 N」。
- 为什么：避免以后有人按文档把这一行删掉。
- 需要你做的：合并这条文档修改（Tier H）。

## What

- In `docs/adr/0084-application-builder-information-architecture.md`, add one row to the homes table of `#amendment-2026-11-26-homes`: `~org` Changes + Publish → the left column's "Changes · N" row (`StudioScopePendingRow`), which opens the existing changes sheet and its publish.
- Add a dated amendment mark in the ADR's own form. Do not add a second table of the pinned row shape.

## Acceptance

- The row is present, `studioMenuPlacement` and the ADR pin tests stay green, and the docs gates pass.
- Wait until PR #37579 merges.
